title: The race
kicker: Lecture 3  ·  RAG against the LLM Wiki
note: text = subtitles; say = spelled for the voice. Every number: experiments/logs/race.json (224 questions, 250-word cap, gemini-3.8-flash answers and judge).

blocks.text: Two ways to remember. Now we race them: the same 224 questions, the same model, the same judge, and the same 250-word limit on every answer.
blocks.say: Two ways to remember. Now we race them: the same two hundred and twenty-four questions, the same model, the same judge, and the same two-hundred-and-fifty-word limit on every answer.

blocks.text: Four lanes: RAG, with keywords and a reranker. The wiki, navigating from index.md. A hybrid that searches the wiki's sections, then navigates. And sections alone. Pasting everything is out: 4.7 million tokens fit no model.
blocks.say: Four lanes: RAG, with keywords and a reranker. The wiki, navigating from index dot M D. A hybrid that searches the wiki's sections, then navigates. And sections alone. Pasting everything is out: four point seven million tokens fit no model.

blocks.text: First, Emma's error code. Go. RAG has its chunks in 43 milliseconds, and its answer in 9.2 seconds. Sections alone finish in 9.1, but miss VAT20-RC. The hybrid takes 13.3. The wiki navigates for six seconds, and answers in 15.7.
blocks.say: First, Emma's error code. Go. RAG has its chunks in forty-three milliseconds, and its answer in nine point two seconds. Sections alone finish in nine point one, but miss VAT twenty R C. The hybrid takes thirteen point three. The wiki navigates for six seconds, and answers in fifteen point seven.

blocks.text: Now Brightcell. Go. All four answer no, and the judge marks all four incomplete. RAG misses the two prices and the switch PUR.CERT_CHK. The wiki misses six facts.
blocks.say: Now Brightcell. Go. All four answer no, and the judge marks all four incomplete. RAG misses the two prices and the switch, P U R dot cert check. The wiki misses six facts.

blocks.text: Across all 224 questions, the hybrid is the most accurate: 92.9 percent. RAG and the wiki tie at 89.3. Sections alone: 79.5.
blocks.say: Across all two hundred and twenty-four questions, the hybrid is the most accurate: ninety-two point nine percent. RAG and the wiki tie at eighty-nine point three. Sections alone: seventy-nine point five.

blocks.text: But watch the clock. RAG's search takes 48 milliseconds. The wiki must navigate first: 23 seconds at the slow end, the hybrid 11. To a full answer, RAG needs 6.2 seconds; the wiki and the hybrid, about 12.5.
blocks.say: But watch the clock. RAG's search takes forty-eight milliseconds. The wiki must navigate first: twenty-three seconds at the slow end, the hybrid eleven. To a full answer, RAG needs six point two seconds; the wiki and the hybrid, about twelve and a half.

blocks.text: And the cost: RAG, under half a cent a question. The hybrid, 2.4 cents; navigation, 3.2. When a document changes, RAG re-indexes with no model at all; the wiki rewrites seven pages, for 15 cents.
blocks.say: And the cost: RAG, under half a cent a question. The hybrid, two point four cents; navigation, three point two. When a document changes, RAG re-indexes with no model at all; the wiki rewrites seven pages, for fifteen cents.

blocks.text: By question type, the wiki wins on procedures and tables. RAG wins on permissions. Questions that join many documents stay hard for every method: 71 percent at best.
blocks.say: By question type, the wiki wins on procedures and tables. RAG wins on permissions. Questions that join many documents stay hard for every method: seventy-one percent at best.

blocks.text: So Ask Northbridge uses RAG: inside the latency budget, nearly as accurate, at a fifth of the cost. The hybrid wiki stays as a measured fallback for when RAG finds nothing.
blocks.say: So Ask Northbridge uses RAG: inside the latency budget, nearly as accurate, at a fifth of the cost. The hybrid wiki stays as a measured fallback for when RAG finds nothing.
